validated_results.reason: Prospective Japanese cohort reporting green tea consumption and incident prostate cancer with a multivariate relative risk.

extraction.comparison_type: 5 or more cups/day versus less than 1 cup/day of green tea
extraction.population: Men aged 40-69 years in the Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study

sample_size.excerpt: The subjects were 49,920 men aged 40-69 years who completed a questionnaire that included their green tea consumption habit at baseline and were followed until the end of 2004. During this time, 404 men were newly diagnosed with prostate cancer, of whom 114 had advanced cases, 271 were localized, and 19 were of an undetermined stage.
